info.name: Registry API: Transcript Request and Document Verification
info.description:
SWE2106 Etivity 5. Test collection for the MUST Academic Registrar transcript request and document verification API.

HOW TO USE
1. Start the server (npm start).
2. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Tokens and ids are saved automatically as collection variables.
3. Change the baseUrl variable if the API is deployed.

SAMPLE ACCOUNTS
Student: 2021/BSE/045 / Student@123
Student 2: 2021/BIT/012 / bit2024
Staff: officer@must.ac.ug / Staff@123
Admin: registrar@must.ac.ug / Admin@123

request.description: Students log in with their registration number. Saves studentToken.

exec: pm.test("Returns a token and role student", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql("student"); });

request.description: Used later to prove one student cannot see another student's request. Saves student2Token.
Creates a request with status pending. Saves requestId.
The student already has a pending official_transcript request.

item.name: Staff tries to submit a request (invalid role)

exec: pm.test("List contains the new request", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("requestId")));

item.name: View one of my requests by id
Request id is not a valid id (invalid)
Student tries to list all requests (invalid role)

exec: pm.test("Every item is pending", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("pending")));

request.description: Generates a unique serial number and marks the request ready. Saves serial.

item.name: Student tries to issue a document (invalid role)

exec: pm.test("Status is ready with the serial attached", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("ready"); pm.expect(d.documentSerial).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("serial")); });

request.description: Saves request2Id, used to demonstrate rejection.

exec: pm.test("Rejected with the reason stored", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("rejected"); pm.expect(d.rejectionReason).to.eql("Outstanding fees not cleared"); });

item.name: Issue document for a rejected request (invalid)

request.description: No Authorization header. Employers and other institutions use this.

exec: pm.test("valid is true and details are returned", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.valid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.data.studentName).to.eql("Akello Grace"); });
